declarations.name: AuiFileUpload
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI FileUpload: `<aui-file-upload>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible label and accessible name (part of the button name).

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the label (it stays in the accessible name).

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name; also set on the native input for native submission.

inputs.name: multiple
inputs.description: Allow several files; a new selection appends. Single mode replaces the file.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: At least one file is required.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disable the button, drop zone, and remove buttons.

inputs.name: acceptTypes
inputs.description: Accepted MIME types ("image/png", "image/*"). Every file is checked.

inputs.name: acceptExtensions
inputs.description: Accepted extensions including the dot (".pdf"). When both lists are set, a file must match both.

inputs.name: maxFileSize
inputs.description: Maximum size of each file, in bytes.

inputs.name: buttonText
inputs.description: Button text. Default: localized "Choose file" / "Choose files".

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the value invalid.

inputs.name: validationTiming
inputs.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

inputs.name: dropZone
inputs.description: Render the drag-and-drop zone around the button.

inputs.name: showConstraints
inputs.description: Render a hint listing the type, size, and count limits.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user added (chooser or drop) or removed files.

outputs.name: rejected
outputs.description: A selection contained files that were not added.

properties.name: rejections
properties.description: Read-only: Files not added by the last selection, with reasons.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: A copy of the selected files.

methods.name: openPicker
methods.description: Open the native chooser (needs user activation).

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now (marks the control submitted) and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); null clears it.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Move focus to the primary focusable element.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

accessibility.pattern: Native <input type="file"> opened by a native <button>; the drop zone is an enhancement (WCAG 2.5.7: dragging is never required).

limitations: Sizes use decimal units (1 kB = 1,000 bytes), as Intl formats them.
Duplicate detection uses name, size, and modification time.
Dropped folders are rejected; folder upload (webkitdirectory) is not supported.
The drag-over highlight depends on the browser exposing "Files" in dataTransfer.types during dragenter.
Without a DataTransfer constructor (very old browsers) the native input cannot be synchronized; getFormValue() stays authoritative.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
